quranTranslation.text: The Beneficent, the Merciful.

explanation.bs: رَحْمٰن i رَحِيم jedno uz drugo, na početku Kur'ana.
explanation.en: رَحْمٰن and رَحِيم side by side, at the opening of the Quran.

quranTranslation.text: Say (unto mankind): Cry unto Allah, or cry unto the Beneficent, unto whichsoever ye cry (it is the same). His are the most beautiful names. And thou (Muhammad), be not loud-voiced in thy worship nor yet silent therein, but follow a way between.

explanation.bs: „Prizivajte Allaha ili prizivajte Milostivog“ – ar-Raḥmān kao ime, ravno imenu Allah.
explanation.en: “Cry unto Allah, or cry unto the Beneficent” — ar-Raḥmān as a name, on a par with the name Allah.

quranTranslation.text: And when it is said unto them: Prostrate to the Beneficent! they say: And what is the Beneficent? Are we to prostrate to whatever thou (Muhammad) biddest us? And it increaseth aversion in them.

explanation.bs: Mušrici pitaju „A šta je to Milostivi?“ – ime koje su odbijali da priznaju.
explanation.en: The idolaters ask “And what is the Beneficent?” — a name they refused to acknowledge.

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who blesseth you, and His angels (bless you), that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and He is ever Merciful to the believers.

explanation.bs: „I On je prema vjernicima uvijek milostiv“; neki mufessiri odatle zaključuju da je رَحِيم milost posebno prema vjernicima (za razliku od رَحْمٰن, koje obuhvata sve).
explanation.en: “He is ever Merciful to the believers”; some mufassirun draw from it that رَحِيم is mercy shown especially to the believers (unlike رَحْمٰن, which embraces all).

quranTranslation.text: Your Allah is One Allah; there is no Allah save Him, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

explanation.bs: Allahova jednoća, a odmah zatim Njegova milost: رَحْمٰن i رَحِيم.
explanation.en: Allah's oneness, followed at once by His mercy: رَحْمٰن and رَحِيم.

quranTranslation.text: Thus We have appointed you a middle nation, that ye may be witnesses against mankind, and that the messenger may be a witness against you. And We appointed the qiblah which ye formerly observed only that We might know him who followeth the messenger, from him who turneth on his heels. In truth it was a hard (test) save for those whom Allah guided. But it was not Allah's purpose that your faith should be in vain, for Allah is Full of Pity, Merciful toward mankind.

explanation.bs: Allah neće dati da propadne vaše vjerovanje – „Allah je, zaista, prema ljudima blag, milostiv“.
explanation.en: Allah would not let your faith go to waste — “Allah is Full of Pity, Merciful toward mankind”.

quranTranslation.text: And of mankind is he who would sell himself, seeking the pleasure of Allah; and Allah hath compassion on (His) bondmen.

explanation.bs: „A Allah je blag prema robovima“ – jedno od dva mjesta bez رَحِيم.
explanation.en: “Allah hath compassion on (His) bondmen” — one of the two places without رَحِيم.

quranTranslation.text: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?

explanation.bs: „Zar je naknada za dobročinstvo išta drugo osim dobročinstva?“ – جَزَاء za dobro.
explanation.en: “Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?” — جَزَاء for good.

quranTranslation.text: The guerdon of an ill-deed is an ill the like thereof. But whosoever pardoneth and amendeth, his wage is the affair of Allah. Lo! He loveth not wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „A naknada za loše djelo je loše djelo poput njega“ – جَزَاء za zlo, po mjeri djela.
explanation.en: “The guerdon of an ill-deed is an ill the like thereof” — جَزَاء for evil, by the deed's measure.

quranTranslation.text: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds).

explanation.bs: „Naknada primjerena“ (جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا) – uzvrat koji odgovara djelima.
explanation.en: “Reward proportioned” (جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا) — requital fitting the deeds.

quranTranslation.text: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

explanation.bs: Poslanici kažu: „Ne tražim od vas za to nikakvu plaću“ – أَجْر kao plaća.
explanation.en: The prophets say: “I ask of you no wage therefor” — أَجْر as a wage.

quranTranslation.text: Then there came unto him one of the two women, walking shyly. She said: Lo! my father biddeth thee, that he may reward thee with a payment for that thou didst water (the flock) for us. Then, when he came unto him and told him the (whole) story, he said: Fear not! Thou hast escaped from the wrongdoing folk.

explanation.bs: „Moj otac te zove da ti uzvrati plaćom za to što si nam napojio (stado)“ – جَزَى i أَجْر u istoj rečenici, plaća za učinjen posao.
explanation.en: “My father biddeth thee, that he may reward thee with a payment for that thou didst water (the flock) for us” — جَزَى and أَجْر in one sentence, payment for work done.

quranTranslation.text: The reward of such will be forgiveness from their Lord, and Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever - a bountiful reward for workers!

explanation.bs: „Kako je lijepa nagrada onih što rade!“ – أَجْر kao Allahova nagrada za trud.
explanation.en: “A bountiful reward for workers!” — أَجْر as Allah's reward for effort.

quranTranslation.text: And their Lord hath heard them (and He saith): Lo! I suffer not the work of any worker, male or female, to be lost. Ye proceed one from another. So those who fled and were driven forth from their homes and suffered damage for My cause, and fought and were slain, verily I shall remit their evil deeds from them and verily I shall bring them into Gardens underneath which rivers flow - A reward from Allah. And with Allah is the fairest of rewards.

explanation.bs: „Nagrada od Allaha – a kod Allaha je najbolja nagrada.“
explanation.en: “A reward from Allah. And with Allah is the fairest of rewards.”

quranTranslation.text: So Allah gave them the reward of the world and the good reward of the Hereafter. Allah loveth those whose deeds are good.

explanation.bs: Allah im je dao nagradu na dunjaluku i lijepu nagradu na ahiretu – ثَوَاب na oba svijeta.
explanation.en: Allah gave them the reward of this world and the good reward of the Hereafter — ثَوَاب in both worlds.

quranTranslation.text: In this case is protection only from Allah, the True, He is Best for reward, and best for consequence.

explanation.bs: Allahova nagrada je najbolja – ثَوَاب kao ono što se vraća vjerniku.
explanation.en: He is best in reward — ثَوَاب as what returns to the believer.

quranTranslation.text: Unto Allah (belongeth) whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; and whether ye make known what is in your minds or hide it, Allah will bring you to account for it. He will forgive whom He will and He will punish whom He will. Allah is Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „Pokažete li ono što nosite u sebi ili to skrijete, Allah će vas za to obračunati“ – pokazati nasuprot skriti.
explanation.en: “Whether ye make known what is in your minds or hide it, Allah will bring you to account for it” — showing set against concealing.

quranTranslation.text: If ye publish your almsgiving, it is well, but if ye hide it and give it to the poor, it will be better for you, and will atone for some of your ill-deeds. Allah is Informed of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „Ako sadake pokažete, to je lijepo, a ako ih sakrijete i date siromasima, to je za vas bolje.“
explanation.en: “If ye publish your almsgiving, it is well, but if ye hide it and give it to the poor, it will be better for you.”

quranTranslation.text: And tell the believing women to lower their gaze and be modest, and to display of their adornment only that which is apparent, and to draw their veils over their bosoms, and not to reveal their adornment save to their own husbands or fathers or husbands' fathers, or their sons or their husbands' sons, or their brothers or their brothers' sons or sisters' sons, or their women, or their slaves, or male attendants who lack vigour, or children who know naught of women's nakedness. And let them not stamp their feet so as to reveal what they hide of their adornment. And turn unto Allah together, O believers, in order that ye may succeed.

explanation.bs: Vjernice „neka ne pokazuju svoje ukrase, izuzev onog što se od njih samo vidi“ – pokazati ono što je pokriveno.
explanation.en: Believing women are told “to display of their adornment only that which is apparent” — showing what is covered.

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the Religion of Truth, that He may cause it to prevail over all religion, however much the idolaters may be averse.

explanation.bs: „Da je uzdigne iznad svake vjere“ – ar-Rāġib: može biti od pojavljivanja, ili od pomaganja i nadvladavanja, tj. da prevlada.
explanation.en: “That He may cause it to prevail over all religion” — ar-Rāġib: it may be from appearing, or from helping and overpowering, i.e. to make it prevail.

gloss.en: to bring to light, to make prevail

quranTranslation.text: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret,

explanation.bs: „On zna skriveno i nikome ne otkriva ono što je skriveno kod Njega“ – ar-Rāġib: ne daje nikome da ga dozna.
explanation.en: “(He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret” — ar-Rāġib: He lets no one become aware of it.

gloss.en: to bring to light, to make prevail

quranTranslation.text: And Pharaoh said: Suffer me to kill Moses, and let him cry unto his Lord. Lo! I fear that he will alter your religion or that he will cause confusion in the land.

explanation.bs: Faraon se boji da Musa „ne učini da se na zemlji pojavi nered“ – učiniti da se nešto pojavi.
explanation.en: Pharaoh fears that Moses “will cause confusion [literally: make corruption appear] in the land” — making a thing appear.

gloss.en: to bring to light, to make prevail

quranTranslation.text: And Allah knoweth that which ye keep hidden and that which ye proclaim.

explanation.bs: „A Allah zna ono što krijete i ono što javno iznosite.“
explanation.en: “And Allah knoweth that which ye keep hidden and that which ye proclaim.”

quranTranslation.text: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.

explanation.bs: Nuh: „Zatim sam im se obraćao javno, a obraćao sam im se i potajno“ – javno nasuprot tajno; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Noah: “And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private” — openly against secretly; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim: „Gospodaru naš, Ti zaista znaš šta mi krijemo i šta javno iznosimo.“
explanation.en: Abraham: “Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim.”

quranTranslation.text: On couches facing one another;

explanation.bs: „na divanima, jedni naspram drugih“ – stanovnici Dženneta sjede licem u lice.
explanation.en: “On couches [surur] facing one another” — the people of the Garden sit face to face.

quranTranslation.text: Wherein are couches raised

explanation.bs: „U njemu su divani uzdignuti“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Wherein are couches [surur] raised” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;

explanation.bs: „Oni i njihove supruge u hladovinama su, na baldahinima naslonjeni.“ – divan pod nadstrešnicom.
explanation.en: “They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones [arāʾik] reclining” — a couch under a canopy.

quranTranslation.text: On couches, gazing,

explanation.bs: „Na baldahinima gledaju.“ – s baldahina se gleda.
explanation.en: “On couches [arāʾik], gazing” — from the canopied couches they look on.

quranTranslation.text: And every man's augury have We fastened to his own neck, and We shall bring forth for him on the Day of Resurrection a book which he will find wide open.

explanation.bs: „Svakom čovjeku smo njegov udes pričvrstili za vrat …“ – ono što je za vrat pričvršćeno ne može se odbaciti; mnogi mufessiri: njegova djela; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And every man's augury have We fastened to his own neck” — what is fastened to the neck cannot be thrown off; many mufassirun: his deeds; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And let not thy hand be chained to thy neck nor open it with a complete opening, lest thou sit down rebuked, denuded.

explanation.bs: „I ne drži ruku vezanu za vrat, a ni ne pružaj je sasvim …“ – slika škrtosti; vrat kao dio tijela.
explanation.en: “And let not thy hand be chained to thy neck nor open it with a complete opening” — an image of stinginess; the neck as a part of the body.

quranTranslation.text: It is not for a believer to kill a believer unless (it be) by mistake. He who hath killed a believer by mistake must set free a believing slave, and pay the blood-money to the family of the slain, unless they remit it as a charity. If he (the victim) be of a people hostile unto you, and he is a believer, then (the penance is) to set free a believing slave. And if he cometh of a folk between whom and you there is a covenant, then the blood-money must be paid unto his folk and (also) a believing slave must be set free. And whoso hath not the wherewithal must fast two consecutive months. A penance from Allah. Allah is Knower, Wise.

explanation.bs: „… neka oslobodi roba vjernika …“ – رَقَبَة je ovdje cijela osoba; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “must set free a believing slave” — the رَقَبَة here is the whole person; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: (It is) to free a slave,

explanation.bs: „osloboditi roba“ – doslovno ‚odriješiti šiju‘ (fakku raqaba).
explanation.en: “(It is) to free a slave,” — literally ‘to unbind a nape’ (fakku raqaba).
